files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+Added type check during initialization of the :mod:`decimal` module to
+prevent a crash in case of broken stdlib.  Patch by Sergey B Kirpichev.

review_comments.body: This will crash if `obj` is NULL. Use `ASSIGN_PTR()`.

issue_comments.body: Did you consider using a [`PyStructSequence`](https://docs.python.org/3/c-api/tuple.html#struct-sequence-objects) instead? It might be a better fit for C code.

I'm not sure about issue itself, see https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/142595#issuecomment-3644329231

But as an excuse for refactoring this sounds much better.  I'll rework the pr.

Hmm, no.  I don't think using [PyStructSequence](https://docs.python.org/3/c-api/tuple.html#struct-sequence-objects) is a good idea.

We can't create this type just with PyStructSequence_NewType.  The namedtype DecimalType supports three arguments, while new type - only one (a sequence).  Probably, I can override tp_new, but at the end - things looks more complex with all this, not simpler.

Thanks @skirpichev for the PR, and @encukou for merging it 🌮🎉.. I'm working now to backport this PR to: 3.13.
🐍🍒⛏🤖

issue_comments.body:
> In general, it might be good to add a way to create PyStructSequences that are more namedtuple-like.  But, yeah, I agree it's too much work for this issue.

I don't think that the amount of work *is* the problem: it seems, that interfaces are different.  The namedtype has additional class method [`_make()`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/collections.html#collections.somenamedtuple._make) with signature of PyStructSequences constructor.

Perhaps, some PyStructSequence_NewType2(), that creates a type with the right constructor?  If not, I think we should just document the difference.  I was certainly misguided by [sentence](https://docs.python.org/3/c-api/tuple.html#struct-sequence-objects):
> Struct sequence objects are the C equivalent of [namedtuple()](https://docs.python.org/3/library/collections.html#collections.namedtuple) objects

Yeah, that should reference the [glossary term](https://docs.python.org/3/glossary.html#term-named-tuple), not `collections.namedtuple` specifically.
Doc fix here: https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/142626

> Perhaps, some PyStructSequence_NewType2(), that creates a type with the right constructor?

Yeah, this, with a new *versioned* variant of `PyStructSequence_Desc` rather than hardcoding the different behaviour.
